title: Aggrega Cache-Slot Metadata
description: The metadata.yaml file written into every source-artifact cache slot alongside blob.tgz. Records the {kind, url, version, digest, mediatype, pulled_at} identity tuple so cache inspection and build-time integrity verification have a single canonical record. The wire shape is closed (additionalProperties: false) and all six fields are required. Schema evolution discipline: adding a new optional field is SemVer-MINOR (additive); removing a field or tightening a constraint is SemVer-MAJOR.

kind.description: The source kind that produced this cache slot. Mirrors the lockfile's source_artifacts[].kind enum; the matching kind is what every build-time consumer reads to choose the right loader.

url.description: The authored URL — the identity URL as written in the Recipe's spec.source.url. For helm-https-chart this is the repo root (repo-root form) or the direct .tgz (direct form) exactly as authored. For git-repository, the cloneable repository URL. For helm-oci-chart, the registry reference. For compose-https-fragment, the fragment's HTTPS URL. The resolved artifact location for a repo-root helm source is recorded separately under `resolved_url:` as provenance.

resolved_url.description: Provenance only: the concrete artifact location the authored URL resolved to at pull time. For a repo-root helm source this is the direct .tgz URL the repository index resolved the chart+version to. Recorded for diagnostics; not part of any integrity contract. Absent when the resolved location equals the authored URL.

version.description: The concrete version the resolver pinned at pull time. For helm-* kinds, the chart version. For git-repository, the commit the authored reference resolved to. Recorded as a single path segment, because it builds the cache slot this metadata sits in, so it carries no `/`, no `\` and no `..`.

digest.description: Content digest of the cached .tar.gz archive in sha256:<hex> form. Build-time verification computes the SHA-256 of blob.tgz, compares it against this field AND the lockfile entry's digest, and halts the build, reporting a content digest mismatch, when either differs.

mediatype.description: Canonical media type the registry advertised (or the kind's default for kinds without registry metadata). Recorded for diagnostic provenance.

pulled_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp recording the pull-time wall clock. Diagnostic provenance only — not part of any integrity contract. The pattern holds the value to the RFC 3339 shape when the metadata is read.
